info.title: Arch-Systems Portal API
info.description: API for industrial operations portal - control room, drilling, engineering, safety, and production management

get.description: Retrieve all webhook endpoints. Admins can see all webhooks, supervisors only see webhooks for their department.

post.description: Create a new webhook endpoint for receiving event notifications. Non-admins can only create webhooks for their department.

department_id.description: Department ID (defaults to user's department if not provided)

put.description: Update an existing webhook endpoint. All fields are optional - only provided fields will be updated. Non-admins can only update webhooks for their department.

delete.description: Soft delete a webhook endpoint (sets deleted_at timestamp). Non-admins can only delete webhooks for their department.

get.description: Retrieve delivery logs for a specific webhook endpoint. Returns the last 50 log entries in reverse chronological order. Non-admins can only view logs for webhooks in their department.
Returns current weather data for the mining site location. Data is not cached to ensure freshness.
Returns the health status and response times of all configured external tools. Results are cached for 60 seconds. Requires authentication.

post.description: Ingests spatial slope displacement metrics from Sentinel-1 / TerraSAR-X GeoTIFF rasters into PostGIS database, Redis cache, and streams live to SAR dashboards.

get.summary: Real-Time InSAR Deformation Telemetry SSE Stream
get.description: Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream subscribing to Redis pub/sub channel `satellite:insar:stream` for live GeoTIFF deformation point updates.

post.description: Forward machine telemetry to FUXA SCADA server with two-level caching (in-memory + Redis). Accepts Supabase webhook payloads or direct tag updates. Deduplicates unchanged values.

500.description: Internal server error or SCADA unreachable

post.description: Ingests real-time IoT metrics from drill rigs (penetration rate, pull-down force, bit depth, RPM) into database and Redis, forwarding updates to SCADA FUXA.

get.summary: Real-Time Drill Rig Telemetry SSE Stream
get.description: Server-Sent Events (SSE) endpoint subscribing to Redis pub/sub channel `drilling:telemetry:stream` to stream live rig telemetry updates.

post.description: Queue a sync playback event via Inngest for offline-first data synchronization. Uses idempotency keys to prevent duplicate processing.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key to prevent duplicate processing

actionType.description: Type of sync action (create, update, delete)

departmentId.description: Department ID for the sync event

400.description: Invalid request body or missing required fields

post.summary: Rust telemetry engine for predictive maintenance
post.description: Calculates wear index and remaining useful life (RUL) for drilling equipment using either native Rust engine or JavaScript fallback. Requires authentication and rate limiting.

isNative.description: Whether results came from native Rust engine

get.description: Exposes Prometheus-compatible metrics including cache performance, Inngest job executions, and database query statistics. For use with Prometheus or Grafana.
Exposes Prometheus-compatible metrics for Control Room operations. This endpoint can be scraped by Prometheus server or Grafana for monitoring and alerting.
Monitors FUXA SCADA server connectivity and response latency. Critical for production monitoring of telemetry integration.
Returns cache statistics including hit rate, hits, misses, and Redis connection status. Monitors the performance of the caching layer used for department slug resolution.

get.summary: Export fleet tire inspection history and scrap logs
get.description: Export fleet tire inspection data, wear profiles, and decommissioning/scrap logs for regulatory and maintenance audits.
Export safety incident records with month-based filtering. Supports JSON and CSV formats (set Accept header to text/csv for CSV).

schema.description: CSV file with safety incident data

get.description: Export production data (coal and waste tonnage) with date range filtering. Supports JSON and CSV formats (set Accept header to text/csv for CSV).
Export machine registry data with optional department filtering. Supports JSON and CSV formats (set Accept header to text/csv for CSV).
Export fuel consumption logs with date range filtering. Supports JSON and CSV formats (set Accept header to text/csv for CSV).

schema.description: CSV file with fuel log data

get.description: Returns the OpenAPI 3.0 specification for all API routes. Requires authentication with admin or engineering role.

post.description: Browsers POST CSP violations here when the policy includes a report-uri or report-to directive. Logs violations for monitoring before enforcing strict CSP. Always returns 204 No Content per CSP spec.

204.description: Report received (always returned per CSP spec)

get.description: Returns completeness metrics for a specific department, date, and shift. Requires authentication.
Returns SCADA server health, Redis fallback telemetry cache status, and active tag metadata for Control Room resilience.

200.description: SCADA status and cached telemetry retrieved

post.description: Validates badge QR codes from C66 hardware scanners. Checks badge status, personnel/visitor authorization, and logs access events. Requires scanner API token authentication.

403.description: Forbidden - unauthorized scanner source or revoked badge

post.summary: Authenticate user with email and password
post.description: Authenticates a user using Supabase auth with rate limiting and CSRF protection

400.description: Invalid request (missing credentials, invalid JSON, or wrong content type)

401.description: Invalid credentials or rate limit exceeded

get.description: Query operational tables (machines, daily_logs, breakdowns, safety_incidents, etc.) with pagination. Admin-only access.

parameters.name: table
parameters.description: Table name (must be in OPERATIONAL_TABLES whitelist)

404.description: Table not found or not allowed

post.description: Insert records into operational tables. Admin-only access with rate limiting for machine status updates.

parameters.name: table
parameters.description: Table name (must be in OPERATIONAL_TABLES whitelist)

schema.description: Record to insert (schema depends on table)

404.description: Table not found or not allowed

put.description: Update records in operational tables. Admin-only access with rate limiting for machine status updates.

parameters.name: table
parameters.description: Table name (must be in OPERATIONAL_TABLES whitelist)

404.description: Table not found or not allowed

delete.description: Delete records from operational tables. Admin-only access.

parameters.name: table
parameters.description: Table name (must be in OPERATIONAL_TABLES whitelist)

404.description: Table not found or not allowed
